sources.observation: Long granite ranges have a repeated window grid, slate roof with dormers and corner spires. The south wall meets a lower terraced landscape.
The west portal rises through a two-tier classical order to a triangular pediment and follows the central courtyard axis.
Four raised basins surround the central courtyard tempietto against the cloister arcade.

limitations: The authorship follows the mapped wings, roof parts and courtyards. Window spacing, dormers, courtyard planting, façade relief and some upper heights are simplified.
The site uses the west plaza elevation inferred from Terrarium. The model supplies courtyard pavement and the base inside the perimeter. The wider gardens, town and paths remain host features.
